request: Native USB controller support in the shared OS, inherited by launcher, games and Doom.

implementation.connector: Dedicated USB-A J10; native HS peripheral 0
implementation.power: USB5V_EN, active-high PI4IOE5V6408 at 0x44/P3, U27 MT9700
implementation.sequence: Power off and read back before host install; register HID before root enable and power on; rollback enable failures; quiesce powers off.
implementation.preserved: Masked register operations preserve every non-USB expander bit; USB-C Serial/JTAG stays independent.
implementation.input: Existing bounded HID parser, canonical broker, game adapters and immediate disconnect neutralization; wired remapping actions enabled.
implementation.scope: One direct wired USB HID gamepad. Hub, multiple pad, XInput/GIP, rumble and Bluetooth support are not added.

official_sources.review: Expander/control, USB connectors and USB-A power switch on pages 1, 4 and 5.

validation.dependencies: Added pinned espressif/usb 1.5.0 and usb_host_hid 1.2.0 to the Tab5 lock; existing dependency versions/hashes preserved.
checks: make verify: passed before firmware integration
make gamepad-host: passed, including parser, hotplug model, host lifecycle, Doom adapter and both six-case USB overlay suites
make tab5-usb-host: passed under ASan/UBSan; all 256 initial output-latch values, non-USB pin preservation and write/readback failure injection
Current Tab5 board tests: all five speaker, sensor and startup recovery cases passed with USB code integrated
make console-shell-host: all seven cases passed after integration, including wired-only controller settings
scripts/build.sh console_os m5stack-tab5: integrated current audio/sensor/game-library snapshot built
Board profile and board-port contract checks: passed
USB and multiplayer skill validation: passed
validation.warnings: No compiler warnings in the final incremental integration build. The initial full build reported existing third-party Doom warnings.
validation.integration: USB patch merged into the primary checkout using a three-way merge with current edits preserved; final build ran from an isolated source snapshot.

items: Exact physical board/connector and controller identification

Cold-plug, hotplug, launcher/game/Lua/Doom mapping, held-button disconnect and repeated reconnect
USB-C content-transfer coexistence and sustained gameplay
Electrical operation and switch behavior on the named physical unit
